entries.zh: 送年：岁末辞岁、馈送年礼（旧俗多以丝绸等物相赠）
entries.en: to see the old year out; a year-end present (customarily of silk) sent as the year passes

entries.zh: 送风：为出行者赠物饯行、助其登程（字面「送风」，西文与「送别」同释互见）
entries.en: send-off present given to a departing traveler ('for the road'); lit. 'to send the wind', paired with 'farewell'

entries.zh: 送别：饯行送别，赠礼以壮行色
entries.en: to bid farewell and see a traveler off with a present for the road

entries.zh: 初次相见所行的礼节性馈赠，即「贽仪」（见面礼金；原卷字头实作「贄儀」，封存件误录作「贊儀」）
entries.en: a courtesy present offered at a first meeting (chih-i, the gift of introduction)

entries.zh: 贽见礼：初次拜见时所携的见面礼（原卷字头实作「贄見礼」，封存件误录作「贊見礼」）
entries.en: visiting present; the gift brought on a (first) call

entries.zh: 折仪：把礼折成银钱相送，以现金代替实物的馈赠
entries.en: to present the gift in money; a cash gift in lieu of goods

entries.zh: 投降：归降、投诚，向其主呈身归服而自缚听命；亦指认输
entries.en: to surrender, submit; to present oneself to one's lord and bind oneself to him

entries.zh: 茶果：以茶叶果品（茶点）馈赠官员之礼；亦泛指待客的茶果点心
entries.en: tea and fruits (sweetmeats) sent as a present to a Mandarin; also refreshments offered to guests
entries.notes: 封存件字头作「茶巢」、音写 te ue，与西文「赠官员之礼」难以对应；查原卷字迹近「茶菓」、原稿音写近 te kue，故按茶果馈赠立义，存疑。

entries.zh: 人事：旧指人情往来所送的礼物、馈赠；又指人间世事
entries.en: a present, courtesy gift (old usage of jen-shih for gifts in social exchange); also human affairs

entries.zh: 贺仪：道贺时所赠的礼金
entries.en: congratulatory gift of money, offered with congratulations

entries.zh: 贺礼：道贺时所赠的礼物
entries.en: congratulatory present

entries.zh: 前：面前、跟前；在……之前（尊前、席前）
entries.en: presence; before, in front of (a superior's presence)

entries.zh: 现：出现、显露；呈现于眼前
entries.en: present; to appear, show oneself, be at hand

entries.zh: 前：面前、尊前；在场
entries.en: presence, before one; present in someone's presence

entries.zh: 面前：当面，在……跟前
entries.en: in front of, in one's presence

entries.zh: 对面会：当面相会、面对面相见
entries.en: to meet face to face

entries.zh: 临时：当时、当下；暂且、一时（非长久）
entries.en: at present, for the time being; temporary, momentary

entries.zh: 浅近：浅显明白、显而易见；近在眼前
entries.en: plain, simple, evident; close at hand (a thing present to view)

entries.zh: 投到：应召报到、赴官投见听传（犹今「报到」）
entries.en: to present oneself when summoned; to report oneself before the authorities

entries.zh: 状：与下条「状元」同义互见，指科举殿试榜首；西文释作「评议会主席」
entries.en: 'President of the council' — same gloss as the next entry; the single char chuang points to the chuang-yuan, top of the palace examination

entries.zh: 状元：科举殿试一甲第一名；本词典西文释作「评议会主席」，系当时西人对科举榜首的理解
entries.en: chuang-yuan: first place in the palace examination, rendered by the friars as 'president of the council'
